regions.today: This morning will be mostly cloudy across Leinster with patchy light rain and drizzle moving southwards. Cloud and drizzle will clear to the south by noon with sunny spells following for the rest of the day. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees with moderate to fresh west to northwest winds
regions.tonight: Tonight will start off mainly dry with clear spells. Scattered showers will extend southwards overnight. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees with moderate to fresh westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be a cool, breezy day with sunshine and showers. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees with fresh, gusty northwesterly winds.
